snippet.title: Stack Prootocol | Store Page Launch Trailer | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937000/Stack_Prootocol/

The Steam page for the game I have been working on, the past couple of months, is finally live:
"A puzzle-platformer with gravity-defying, block-stacking action. Play as Meep, a RAM-loving USB-mouse, on a quest in cyberspace to repair a broken toaster. Create new paths and jump to your goal—but watch out for the digital void! "

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/darelooks.dev
Website: https://darelooks.dev
